To our valued community,

We want to take a moment to address the recent service disruption. At Halcyon, transparency and trust are paramount, and we recognize that we fell short of the high standards you've come to expect from us.

It's important to note that the security of your data remains our top priority. Our dedicated team worked tirelessly to resolve the issue and is committed to implementing robust safeguards moving forward. This incident underscores our unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.

We understand that this may have caused frustration, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience. Your feedback plays a pivotal role in shaping a more resilient, seamless, and secure experience for everyone.

We are deeply grateful for your patience and continued support as we embark on this journey together.

Warm regards,
The Halcyon Team
